title: Publish an authorized retained candidate
description: Perform the selected external publication using retained qualified bytes and applicable exact-candidate authorization. It preserves provider identity, authentication/provenance, conflict, and uncertain-write boundaries.
inputs: Retained sealed candidate and its actual qualified artifacts.
Applicable candidate-specific authorization, supported publication path and credentials, and fresh external conflict/evidence basis.
preconditions: Applicable policy permits the selected execution path; absence is reported rather than bypassed.
outputs: Attributable attempted publication and actual known provider outcomes.
Blocked mismatch/authority/authentication/conflict or uncertain/partial write requiring recovery assessment.
behavior: Check candidate, source/tag, version/channel, destinations, configuration, evidence, and authority against the approved subject before writes.
Use the selected trusted publishing or specifically authorized fallback while preserving stricter profile requirements and honest provenance.
Publish retained artifacts without regeneration from a mutable working basis; reject conflicting public identities and unguarded alternate trigger paths.
Suppress secrets and private environment details in commands, artifacts, and durable outcomes.
Record known effects and stop on uncertainty instead of treating workflow serialization or a duplicate event as permission to repeat publication.

failure_behavior.condition: Authorization is absent, candidate identity changed, or required support is stale or failed.
failure_behavior.outcome: Withhold publication and identify the unmet boundary.

failure_behavior.condition: Public tag/artifact identity conflicts or the supported authentication path is unavailable.
failure_behavior.outcome: Stop without overwrite, silent fallback, or a new unapproved path.

failure_behavior.condition: An external write has an uncertain or partial outcome.
failure_behavior.outcome: Record known effects and transfer to external-state inspection before any retry.
